== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Stormtrooper Utility Belt (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Stormtrooper Utility Belt]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.categoryonegames.com/catalog/star_wars_ccg-swccg_premiere_sw_2pg_japanese/stromtrooper_utility_belt_japanese_white_border/50658 CategoryOneGames], [https://cc-client-assets.cdn.crystalcommerce.com/photo/categoryonegames/file/74aa8edfc9e1465ebec8084607fc20b0/IMG_20240101_0009.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(6, 6, 626, 934)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>01ef110ff5bd4dc3ffc6e51f8bb090babc8ec03ae038e79962b779956e14c8fd</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
